test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Sita loves her __glass container in which she has many fish. __
solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"aquarium"** refers to a transparent tank of water in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept. (काच का पात्र जिसमें मछलियाँ रखी जाती हैं) • **Example: **She spent hours watching the fish swim in the aquarium. • **"Glass container in which she has many fish"** is specifically described by the term "aquarium". (काच का पात्र जिसमें मछलियाँ रखी जाती हैं) • **Example: **Sita loves her aquarium because it has many colorful fish. Therefore, the correct answer is: **aquarium**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Cannister** (डिब्बा): A container with a lid, used for storing dry products. • **Example:** She keeps her cookies in a cannister to maintain their freshness. • **Planetarium** (नक्षत्रशाला): A building or room in which images of stars, planets, and constellations are projected on a domed ceiling. • **Example: **The children were excited to visit the planetarium to learn about the solar system. • **Museum** (संग्रहालय): A building where objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural interest are stored and exhibited. • **Example:** The museum houses an impressive collection of ancient artifacts. 44:T966, The correct answer is o**ption 2)**
